name: Castaway Cay Cookie's BBQ & Cookie's Too: Rotisserie Chicken, Burgers & BBQ Ribs
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Castaway Cay · Cookie's BBQ, Cookie's Too & Serenity Bay BBQ
whyItWorks: Interior carved rotisserie chicken breast, plain flame-grilled hamburgers, and steamed jasmine rice make an easy beach lunch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off the lemon-rosemary chicken skin to eat the tender interior white meat with steamed jasmine rice and plain potato chips, or grab a plain burger on a white bun. Skip raw coleslaw, corn on the cob, and spicy ribs.
watchOuts: Lemon-rosemary marinade on outer chicken skin (remove skin)
Strictly skip corn on the cob and raw cabbage slaw
